description: Permissions the Remoter window needs. Tauri v2 denies every command that is not granted here, and a denial arrives in the interface as an ordinary rejected promise — so an omission is not a visible error, it is a control that fails and then explains itself wrongly. Full screen was exactly that: MainWindow.tsx's F11 handler calls is_fullscreen and then set_fullscreen, only the first was granted, and the catch told the user there was no window to resize. Callers, so that a grant is traceable to the thing that needs it: start-dragging is every data-tauri-drag-region title bar; minimize, maximize, unmaximize, toggle-maximize, is-maximized, close and start-resize-dragging are the window controls in TitleBar.tsx and WindowChrome.tsx; set-fullscreen and is-fullscreen are the full-screen shortcut; set-focus and set-title are for the shell to raise and label the window. is-fullscreen and is-maximized are already inside core:window:default and are named again so that the read half of a pair is as visible as the write half. dialog open and save are the file pickers in the vault, import, audit-export and file-manager screens; message and confirm are granted for the dialog plugin's own prompts and have no caller in this build. opener open-url is About, Updates and a hyperlink clicked in a terminal.
